Plot decoder

Point your camera at a plot with the four corner targets, or use a photo. For a piece with corner targets only, scan its settings label first, then the front. The whole page needs to be in the frame, flat, in even light.

starting the camera

Reads plots from the purloined plot studio, the cipher garden and the signal book with machine marks on, including retrofit marks plotted onto a finished sheet afterwards. Nothing leaves your phone: photos are read on the device. Encoders from Unravel the Purloined at commit dev. Classical ciphers are historical puzzles, not modern security.
